package domain

import (
	"errors"
	"strings"
	"time"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const (
	// SubjectLearningActionClosed is the student-owned action finalization trigger.
	SubjectLearningActionClosed = "learning_action.closed"
	// LearningActionClosedSchemaVersion is the current closure payload schema.
	LearningActionClosedSchemaVersion = 1
	// LearningActionCodeContextPolicyVersion identifies the bounded, secret-safe
	// workspace projection exposed to teacher orchestration.
	LearningActionCodeContextPolicyVersion = "student-learning-action-code-context-v1"
	SandboxValidationObservationVersion    = "sandbox-validation-observation-v1"
)

// StudentLearningAction is one immutable work cycle. One answer may own
// multiple cycles when FAILED or REJECTED activity reopens the answer.
type StudentLearningAction struct {
	ID                   string
	StudentTaskAnswerID  string
	StudentID            string
	TaskID               string
	Cycle                int
	ContextType          LearningContextType
	ContextID            string
	LearningTargets      []LearningTargetRef
	EvidenceClass        LearningEvidenceClass
	Outcome              LearningActionOutcome
	OutcomePolicyVersion string
	OpenedAt             time.Time
	ClosedAt             *time.Time
}

// LearningActionStatus exposes lifecycle only. Objective outcome remains
// private to the student-owned evidence reducer.
type LearningActionStatus string

const (
	LearningActionStatusOpen   LearningActionStatus = "OPEN"
	LearningActionStatusClosed LearningActionStatus = "CLOSED"
)

// LearningActionContext is the bounded, safe read projection used by teacher
// orchestration. It deliberately excludes answer identity and objective result.
type LearningActionContext struct {
	LearningActionID string               `json:"learning_action_id"`
	StudentID        string               `json:"student_id"`
	TaskID           string               `json:"task_id"`
	ContextType      LearningContextType  `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID        string               `json:"context_id"`
	LearningTargets  []LearningTargetRef  `json:"learning_targets"`
	Status           LearningActionStatus `json:"status"`
	OpenedAt         time.Time            `json:"opened_at"`
}

// LearningActionCodeFile is a bounded text-only workspace file. Sandbox and
// answer identities, binary content, dependencies, build artifacts, and known
// secret files are deliberately absent.
type LearningActionCodeFile struct {
	Path      string `json:"path"`
	Content   string `json:"content"`
	Truncated bool   `json:"truncated"`
}

type LearningActionValidationObservation struct {
	Available     bool       `json:"available"`
	Kind          string     `json:"kind"`
	Passed        bool       `json:"passed"`
	IssueCount    int        `json:"issue_count"`
	CheckedAt     *time.Time `json:"checked_at,omitempty"`
	PolicyVersion string     `json:"policy_version"`
}

// LearningActionCodeContext is an ownership-scoped transient Sandbox
// projection for one open learning action. It contains no validator result.
type LearningActionCodeContext struct {
	LearningActionID string                              `json:"learning_action_id"`
	StudentID        string                              `json:"student_id"`
	TaskID           string                              `json:"task_id"`
	Available        bool                                `json:"available"`
	Files            []LearningActionCodeFile            `json:"files"`
	OmittedFileCount int                                 `json:"omitted_file_count"`
	Truncated        bool                                `json:"truncated"`
	PolicyVersion    string                              `json:"policy_version"`
	Validation       LearningActionValidationObservation `json:"validation"`
}

// NewLearningActionCodeContext validates the public size and identity
// boundary independently from the Sandbox implementation.
func NewLearningActionCodeContext(input LearningActionCodeContext) (LearningActionCodeContext, error) {
	input.LearningActionID = strings.TrimSpace(input.LearningActionID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.TaskID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskID)
	input.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.PolicyVersion)
	input.Validation.Kind = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(input.Validation.Kind))
	input.Validation.PolicyVersion = strings.TrimSpace(input.Validation.PolicyVersion)
	if input.Validation.CheckedAt != nil {
		checkedAt := input.Validation.CheckedAt.UTC()
		input.Validation.CheckedAt = &checkedAt
	}
	if !validLearningUUID(input.LearningActionID) || !validLearningUUID(input.StudentID) || !validLearningUUID(input.TaskID) ||
		input.PolicyVersion != LearningActionCodeContextPolicyVersion || len(input.Files) > 12 ||
		input.Validation.PolicyVersion != SandboxValidationObservationVersion || !validLearningActionValidation(input.Validation) ||
		input.OmittedFileCount < 0 || input.OmittedFileCount > 100_000 || (!input.Available && (len(input.Files) != 0 || input.OmittedFileCount != 0 || input.Truncated || input.Validation.Available)) {
		return LearningActionCodeContext{}, errors.New("invalid learning action code context")
	}
	files := make([]LearningActionCodeFile, len(input.Files))
	seen, totalBytes, hasTruncatedFile := make(map[string]struct{}, len(input.Files)), 0, false
	for index, file := range input.Files {
		file.Path = strings.TrimSpace(strings.ReplaceAll(file.Path, "\\", "/"))
		if file.Path == "" || len(file.Path) > 300 || strings.HasPrefix(file.Path, "/") ||
			strings.Contains("/"+file.Path+"/", "/../") || strings.ContainsRune(file.Path, '\x00') ||
			!utf8.ValidString(file.Path) || !utf8.ValidString(file.Content) || strings.ContainsRune(file.Content, '\x00') || len(file.Content) > 16<<10 {
			return LearningActionCodeContext{}, errors.New("invalid learning action code file")
		}
		if _, exists := seen[file.Path]; exists {
			return LearningActionCodeContext{}, errors.New("duplicate learning action code file")
		}
		seen[file.Path] = struct{}{}
		totalBytes += len(file.Content)
		hasTruncatedFile = hasTruncatedFile || file.Truncated
		files[index] = file
	}
	if totalBytes > 64<<10 || input.Truncated != (input.OmittedFileCount > 0 || hasTruncatedFile) {
		return LearningActionCodeContext{}, errors.New("invalid learning action code bounds")
	}
	input.Files = files
	return input, nil
}

func validLearningActionValidation(input LearningActionValidationObservation) bool {
	if input.IssueCount < 0 || input.IssueCount > 10_000 {
		return false
	}
	if !input.Available {
		return input.Kind == "" && !input.Passed && input.IssueCount == 0 && input.CheckedAt == nil
	}
	if (input.Kind != "validation" && input.Kind != "tests") || input.CheckedAt == nil {
		return false
	}
	if input.CheckedAt.IsZero() {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// NewLearningActionContext projects only trusted action identity, frozen
// targets, and lifecycle state from the student-owned record.
func NewLearningActionContext(action StudentLearningAction) (LearningActionContext, error) {
	action.ID = strings.TrimSpace(action.ID)
	action.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(action.StudentID)
	action.TaskID = strings.TrimSpace(action.TaskID)
	action.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(action.ContextID)
	action.OpenedAt = action.OpenedAt.UTC()
	if !validLearningUUID(action.ID) || !validLearningUUID(action.StudentID) || !validLearningUUID(action.TaskID) ||
		!validLearningActionContextType(action.ContextType) || !validLearningValue(action.ContextID, 255) || action.OpenedAt.IsZero() {
		return LearningActionContext{}, errors.New("invalid learning action context")
	}
	if action.ClosedAt != nil {
		closedAt := action.ClosedAt.UTC()
		if closedAt.IsZero() || closedAt.Before(action.OpenedAt) {
			return LearningActionContext{}, errors.New("invalid learning action lifecycle")
		}
	}
	targets, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(action.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return LearningActionContext{}, err
	}
	status := LearningActionStatusOpen
	if action.ClosedAt != nil {
		status = LearningActionStatusClosed
	}
	return LearningActionContext{
		LearningActionID: action.ID,
		StudentID:        action.StudentID,
		TaskID:           action.TaskID,
		ContextType:      action.ContextType,
		ContextID:        action.ContextID,
		LearningTargets:  targets,
		Status:           status,
		OpenedAt:         action.OpenedAt,
	}, nil
}

// LearningActionClosedEventData intentionally excludes objective outcome,
// score, confidence, and mastery. Student keeps those facts locally.
type LearningActionClosedEventData struct {
	LearningActionID string              `json:"learning_action_id"`
	ContextType      LearningContextType `json:"context_type"`
	ContextID        string              `json:"context_id"`
	LearningTargets  []LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
}

// NewStudentLearningAction validates one open cycle and freezes target order.
func NewStudentLearningAction(input StudentLearningAction) (StudentLearningAction, error) {
	return normalizeStudentLearningAction(input, true)
}

func normalizeStudentLearningAction(input StudentLearningAction, requireEvidenceClass bool) (StudentLearningAction, error) {
	input.ID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ID)
	input.StudentTaskAnswerID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentTaskAnswerID)
	input.StudentID = strings.TrimSpace(input.StudentID)
	input.TaskID = strings.TrimSpace(input.TaskID)
	input.ContextID = strings.TrimSpace(input.ContextID)
	input.OpenedAt = input.OpenedAt.UTC()
	if !validLearningUUID(input.ID) || !validLearningUUID(input.StudentTaskAnswerID) ||
		input.ID == input.StudentTaskAnswerID || !validLearningUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validLearningUUID(input.TaskID) || !validLearningContextType(input.ContextType) ||
		!validLearningValue(input.ContextID, 255) || input.OpenedAt.IsZero() || input.ClosedAt != nil || input.Cycle < 0 ||
		input.Outcome != "" || strings.TrimSpace(input.OutcomePolicyVersion) != "" {
		return StudentLearningAction{}, errors.New("invalid student learning action")
	}
	targets, err := NormalizeLearningTargetRefs(input.LearningTargets)
	if err != nil {
		return StudentLearningAction{}, err
	}
	if requireEvidenceClass && !IsLearningEvidenceClass(input.EvidenceClass) {
		return StudentLearningAction{}, errors.New("learning action evidence class is required")
	}
	if input.EvidenceClass != "" && !IsLearningEvidenceClass(input.EvidenceClass) {
		return StudentLearningAction{}, errors.New("invalid learning action evidence class")
	}
	input.LearningTargets = targets
	return input, nil
}

// NewLearningActionClosedEvent creates the trigger consumed by teacher-agent.
func NewLearningActionClosedEvent(eventID string, action StudentLearningAction, closedAt time.Time) (IntegrationEvent, error) {
	normalized, err := normalizeStudentLearningAction(action, false)
	if err != nil {
		return IntegrationEvent{}, err
	}
	closedAt = closedAt.UTC()
	if closedAt.IsZero() || closedAt.Before(normalized.OpenedAt) {
		return IntegrationEvent{}, errors.New("invalid learning action closure time")
	}
	return NewIntegrationEvent(
		eventID,
		SubjectLearningActionClosed,
		normalized.ID,
		normalized.StudentTaskAnswerID,
		normalized.StudentID,
		closedAt,
		LearningActionClosedSchemaVersion,
		LearningActionClosedEventData{
			LearningActionID: normalized.ID,
			ContextType:      normalized.ContextType,
			ContextID:        normalized.ContextID,
			LearningTargets:  normalized.LearningTargets,
		},
	)
}
